evidence: Independent read-only security review of the requested frozen candidate. Verified every one of the 55 candidate-listed non-evidence untracked files in .codex/worktrees/phase2-msgpack-market-frames against its declared SHA-256; all matched. Independently computed the worktree tracked diff from baseline ea9a83e069f1be79c307fd8a9c4b9fca85977409 with git diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff and SHA-256; it matched candidate tracked_diff_sha256 222485975962498081e60cfee41ca6ffe42a7ea2a0983ca86b8bd112391f4b95. Candidate task and bundle metadata match this review request. PAPER boundary: mode is literal paper and assertPaperOnly binds the Alpaca account adapter to https://paper-api.alpaca.markets; account adapter only issues GET requests and has no order-write method; no live trading route is present in the API code. Local controls: localTestMode schema requires loopback app/database hosts and rejects Alpaca/OpenRouter credentials; main starts no provider clients in local mode; compose publishes Postgres only on 127.0.0.1; local control routes are registered only when the validated local harness is enabled. Local route logs/traces record route templates, status, virtual timestamps and fixed event labels, not query strings, request bodies, or headers. Failure details from providers are mapped to fixed error codes. Account scenario and fixture response construction normalize/select known fields; unknown credential-shaped fields are not reflected in normalized state or provider responses. Trade-update hints use bounded batches and explicit field selection and remain observational: ingestion does not mutate canonical positions or orders. Fixture inputs are byte-bounded, fatal UTF-8 decoded, strict-schema validated, and count/value bounded; MessagePack market frames are capped at 256 KiB with decoder collection/string/bin limits, depth checks and safe fixed errors. External frame controls discard provider messages and preserve only bounded allowlisted state. No security finding identified in the candidate. This is source review only; it does not establish live Alpaca codec/auth interoperability or credential-backed PAPER qualification.
